description: N0/N1 fair comparison on one A100: pinned Qwen3.5-2B-Base, BF16, text only. External engines run from their own venvs (see docs/notebooks/colab_a100_engine_scorecard.ipynb). Differences that remain are recorded here, not hidden.

profiles.name: native_unfused
profiles.notes: foundry candidate manifest pins the same Hugging Face revision

profiles.name: native_full
profiles.notes: all qualified fusions; MLP/full greedy-output divergence is under investigation, so this lane is a performance measurement only

profiles.name: native_static
profiles.notes: native_full plus the v1.7 static decode lane (CUDA-graph replay over a fixed slot pool, strict: setup failure stops the server); kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_budget
profiles.notes: native_static plus N3.1 token-budget prefill (8192 tokens per forward when idle, 1024 while decoding); kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_fla
profiles.notes: native_budget plus N3.3 GDN prefill on the fused FLA kernel (flash-linear-attention 0.6.0); needs the fla install step; kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_backlog
profiles.notes: native_fla plus N4.1 backlog-aware busy prefill budget (queued prompt tokens drain in about 4 forwards while decoding); needs the fla install step; kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_conv
profiles.notes: native_backlog plus N4.2 GDN prefill conv on FLA's fused Triton conv + SiLU ([B, T, D], no transposes); needs the fla install step; kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_drain
profiles.notes: native_conv with prefill-first draining (one forward may take the whole queued backlog, up to 16384 tokens, while decoding); kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_dattn
profiles.notes: native_drain plus N5.1 split-KV GQA decode attention in the static lane; needs the fla install step; kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_spec
profiles.notes: native_dattn plus N6.2 MTP speculative decode (one draft, lossless greedy); needs the fla install step; kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_packed
profiles.notes: native_spec plus P1 packed prefill straight into the static pool; needs the fla install step; kept only if the whole scorecard improves

profiles.name: native_graphs
profiles.notes: v1.15 plus P4 CUDA-graphed small packed prefills; needs the fla install step

profiles.name: native_radix
profiles.notes: v1.16 plus P5 per-layer sync removal and first-sight prefix snapshots (3 GB, 128 entries); needs the fla install step

profiles.name: vllm
profiles.notes: engine defaults otherwise (prefix caching and CUDA graphs as shipped); version recorded from /version

profiles.name: sglang
profiles.notes: engine defaults otherwise (radix cache as shipped); version recorded from /get_server_info
